# registry_scanning_config (Data Source)

Reads the backend security scanner configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "registry_scanning_config" "current" {}

output "scanning_enabled" {
  value = data.registry_scanning_config.current.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `binary_path` (String) Path to the scanner binary.
- `detected_version` (String) Detected scanner version string.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether security scanning is enabled.
- `enabled_tools` (List of String) List of enabled scanning tools.
